newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Textiles slump hits Stork systems.
newsitem.headline: Textiles slump hits Stork systems.

text.p: Stork NV said on Wednesday sluggish world textile sales were the main reason for a slight dip in operating profit at its industrial systems and components business group.
The group's first-half 1996 operating profit fell to 46 million guilders from 48 million in the same period of 1995.

Stork said the malaise in textiles had led to reduced investment in new production systems, though the sale of components and other supplies for the existing installed base of machinery had remained at a reasonable level.
Operating profits from sales of systems and components for the food processing industry were higher than in the first half of 1995, Stork said.
